m.x: Hello, Master. We ... we finally meet again.

o: Glad to have you as my student.

b.x: I've been doing great—thanks to you!

m.x: N-no, it's the other way around!
I hope I can have more chances to learn from you!
Master, I ... I've been a little troubled lately.
At the camp, people I've never met keep greeting me.
They're all so friendly. Some even look like they admire me.
But I don't know their names, and I never know how to respond.
Looks like you've become quite the celebrity, Fuyuka.
E-eek, M-Master, please don't make fun of me.

b.x: I'm not really used to it yet, but ... I want to deal with it on my own.
I-I know... It just takes some getting used to, still...

m.x: You've got this!
Yes, I'll do my best!
Fuyuka, there's something I've always wondered.
Y-yes, Master?
Your weapon looks unusual... It's big and heavy.
How do you maintain it?
There's nothing special...
I oil it regularly, wipe it clean after battles
and store it in a special cabinet at home.
When I'm out in the Wilds, though,
sometimes it's too big to fit anywhere properly,
so I just keep it by my side.

o: You don't worry about losing it?
I see. It is way too heavy.

b.x: No, most people can't even lift it.

m.x: A few have tried, but I'm the only one who can.
Impressive, Fuyuka.
Hehe, I guess I do have some confidence in my strength.
If you ever need help with any heavy lifting, Master, please let me know!
Fuyuka, there's something that's always puzzled me.
Yes?
Don't you feel hot wearing like that?
Your outfit always gives off such a winter vibe.
Uh... I never noticed...
It looks all warm and fuzzy. I can imagine it's perfect for winter.
But what about summer?
Doesn't it make you prone to sweating?
No! I don't sweat!
A-and even if I did, I wouldn't smell. So please don't worry!
Uh, that's not what I meant...
Today's the meetup day for the Petal Bloom and the New Star Guild!
Could you please bring everyone in New Star Guild over, Master?
How unusual.
Usually it's Kaede or Nazuna who does the inviting.
Umm... I... I volunteered for the job.
I'd like to handle these invitations from now on.
I figured... If I can't even talk about things like this with you, Master...
It'll be even harder with anyone else.
Then I'm honored to be your practice partner.
Master! It is an urgent situation!!!

o: Did the dog eat your homework?

b.x: I have something important I'd like to discuss with you.
Ahem. Nothing, just my feeble attempt at humor.

m.x: Just tell me.
R-right. So, there's going to be a joint operation soon—
We'll be partnering up with another guild.
And ... I'm not sure how to carry myself around them.
Don't worry. I've been paying close attention to your battles.
Just do what you always do.
That's all...?
Yup. That's all.
B-but unlike the other leaders...
I can't do speeches or pep talks...
Every leader has their own strengths.
Yours is leading from the front.
When people see you charging ahead
they'll find their courage too.
You ... really think so?
I think I'm beginning to understand...
Do you have a bit of free time today, Master?
Th-there's a place that I'd like to go to.
Would you come with me?
Would this be a date?
Just kidding.
D-date...!
Going on a date with someone like me would be a total waste of time!
I just... I feel like I've grown a bit
and I've been seeing things differently lately.
And I'd like to share some thoughts with you.
I'm looking forward to it.
Also, being with you is never a waste of time.
I just want to get that on the record.
Uh... Yes. I understand.
Happy birthday!
Eh? Birthday?
Oh—it's your birthday today, Master?
Happy birthday!
Thank you for everything you've done for me.
I meant ... it's your birthday today.
I'm here to celebrate you.
Whaaat?!
S-sorry, I got it mixed up!
Then, Master, will you come to my birthday party?
I'm heading over right now!
T-that's great! I'll start getting ready!
I've been watching you fight lately.
You seem much more at ease out there.
Y-yes! It's all thanks to your training, Master.
I finally understand what strength really means.
When I think only of protecting my friends
I can fight at my full power.
Keep up the good work.
Yup, I will!
I listened to the Runic Disc you sent me last time, Master.
Yeah?
It feels ... nostalgic, somehow.
Everyone says that.
Did you think of things from the past?
Y-yes...
Unlike those amazing Trekkers
I've had a perfectly ordinary past.
I grew up in a small town, around ordinary people.
But ... I don't know how to put it...
That kind of ordinary life is precisely what's worth protecting.
Y-yes! Exactly!
You can read me like a book...
Heh, after hearing that track, I feel so full of energy.
Thank you, Master!
Master!
What is it? You sound unusually happy
Hehe, the senpais have been saying that I've improved a lot lately
They say I'm starting to look like a proper guild leader
Congrats! Good for you!
I'm sure more and more people will recognize your leadership abilities!
Yeah!
I'm so grateful for having you as my Master
It's not just because of me
All this comes from your willingness to work hard and change yourself
Keep it up
Master...
I feel like working for a company
is completely different from being a Trekker
One values rules, structure, and stability
The other stands for freedom and adventure
It's natural to feel out of place
But whenever I think that you'll help me
I feel like I can face either kind of life
Ah... Does that trouble you?
Of course not
Whenever you want, you can come to me for help
Yay!
Hehe, I feel relieved again...
Master!
There's something I still don't quite understand
What is it?
Whenever I go to accept commissions with the senpais
I get so nervous every time that I can't say a word
But they always tell me it's fine, I should just keep looking like that
And the clients don't seem to mind, either
Still, I'm afraid that I'm being impolite...
Fuyuka, that's because other people see you like that
They saw you as the stern, unsmiling type to begin with
Even though that's far from the truth
It makes people with bad intentions think twice before trying to trick you
I see
Still... Can I really keep this up forever?
If you want to show your true self to others
You'll need to put in more effort than you do now
But I'm with you, Fuyuka
Okay. Thank you, Master!
Master! Master!
Please praise me!
It's rare to see you so eager
Did something happen?
I've gotten to the point where I can ask to do out-of-town commissions on my own
and communicate directly with clients!
Wow, that's a big deal
How did you accomplish this?
It's as you taught me last time
Explain the situation as clearly as possible during the initial contact phase
Then plan for contingencies and figure out what to say in case they happened
That helps with completing the commission itself, too
Yeah!
Just remember to watch out for unplannable risks
Hehe, that's why before every trip
I would always set a time with others
If anything went wrong, they would come and back me up
That's amazing. You really thought it through
You've truly grown
Master, would you come to the forest with me?
It's rare for you to invite me like this
I usually worry about bothering you too much
But this time, it's not just about me
I want to visit some old friends with you
Friends who live in the forest?
Oh, you mean that bird pack?
They might have flown away by now
Winter has come to an end
They should be heading to their next destination
Yes, I just want to make sure
Sure, I'll go with you
Thank you, Master!
Come to think of it, you're always encouraging and praising me
Because you always work hard
Or is criticism what you actually want?
N-no way!
Just imagining you scolding me makes me want to cry!
I'm already tearing up now...
Don't! I was just joking!
I... I was just worried that maybe you're being too nice...
And not always telling me the truth
Maybe I'm not that great...
Fuyuka, you've always been good at a lot of things
Such as...?

b.x: That really is my only strong point
Even while fully equipped, you can move without making a sound
... Uh, that's because... I was always scared of running into people...
So that's how I got my stealth skills

m.x: The point is
even if you never changed at all, nobody can look down on you
And now, you're been even more awesome
Master...
Your words always warm my heart
